problems.message: ownLikes inherits horizon-free public sync (`sync public`, no horizon) from likes; its explicit `read <- .principal = viewer` (at schema.q:93:3) conflicts with that public audience. A maintained view cannot declare a separate sync audience
problems.rewrite: For own-state existence, replace ownLikes with `sync public last 2000 by .at, .id with own keys .principal` on likes, and replace its Boolean lookups with `exists likes[post, viewer]`; remove the summary's declaration and read/sync lines. This keeps the public window and supplies complete own-key absence offline. For aggregate totals instead: remove the view's sync line, then keep `read <- allow` (or omit read) to retain this public offline summary: every device receives every group, including other viewers' keys; use `online only` to keep the narrower read on the server and lose offline aggregate/absence coverage. For viewer-owned existence on an eligible public window, use source owner-key coverage with ordinary `exists` instead of this summary; this does not supply aggregate totals. Measure replica rows and bytes with `snapback4 test --residency`; guide maintains; guide offline-interactions
